source.section: Form MO-1040 PDF p2 Lines 1-8 and 14-15, PDF p3 Lines 25-30 (instructions PDF pp6-9); Instructions PDF p8 Line 14 standard deductions; PDF p21 Tax Rate Chart Sections A and B; record base.deductions; Form MO-A PDF p3 Part 3 Section B Lines 1-9; instructions PDF p17; Reference Guide PDF p9; record private_pension_subtraction; Form MO-A PDF p1 Part 1 Line 10; instructions PDF p14 Line 10; record military_retirement_subtraction

worked: Single, age 60. Military retirement is a Part 1 subtraction, so it is out of Line 6 and of the income test. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 22,000.00 + pensions 46,000.00 = 68,000.00. Federal taxable income = 68,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 52,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 68,000.00. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 68,000.00. Line 4 subtractions: MO-A Part 1 Line 10 military retirement benefits 40,000.00; total 40,000.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 68,000.00 - 40,000.00 = 28,000.00. Section B: Line 1 28,000.00; Line 2 0.00; Line 3 28,000.00; Line 4 25,000.00; Line 5 3,000.00; Line 6Y 6,000.00, Line 7Y 6,000.00; Line 8 6,000.00; Line 9 3,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 3,000.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 28,000.00 - 3,000.00 - 15,750.00 = 9,250.00. Line 29 taxable income 9,250.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,313.00 = 26.26 + 2.5% x 1,313.00 = 32.825 + 3% x 1,313.00 = 39.39 + 3.5% x 1,313.00 = 45.955 + 4% x 1,313.00 = 52.52 + 4.5% x 1,313.00 = 59.085 + 4.7% x 59.00 = 2.773; total 258.808 = 258.81. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 259; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 28,000.00 - Line 8 3,000.00 = 25,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 28,000.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
